seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION2 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: born x2, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

A1/A2 move selection one block row; A3/A4 move selected piece (blocked by edge/other pieces), no-op for axis.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; layers piece > reflection > target > axis.
HUD col 63: one 11->12 from the top per effective action (no-ops do not tick).
